predecessors.name: Caliphate of Córdoba
predecessors.text: Córdoba and its vicinity, where the aristocracy ended the caliphate with the overthrow of Hisham III in 1031

successors.name: Taifa of Seville
successors.text: Córdoba, captured in 1070 by al-Mu'tamid of Seville

ledger.x: 1031: Córdoba becomes a republic under the Jahwarids once the caliphate falls.
1070: 'In 1070, after defeating the Toledan army, al-Mu'tamid captured Córdoba and deposed 'Abd al-Malik', who was imprisoned and exiled to Saltés.
1070: the Jahwarid republic ends; 'Seville lost control of Córdoba from 1075 to 1078' and kept it until 1091.

wars.name: Seville's conquest of Córdoba
wars.outcome: Al-Mu'tamid of Seville defeated the Toledan army and captured Córdoba in 1070, deposing Abd al-Malik.

certainty.note: City-state: 'Córdoba and its vicinity' with no boundary on the page.
